objective: Add safe agent event telemetry and a Persian viewer that separates public GitHub CI events from imported self-reported non-live agent traces.
scope: Introduce a bounded, standard-library append-only hash-chain agent event recorder with cross-process locking.
Implement strict event schema and negative tests for tampering, secrets, path traversal and financial mode.
Add a standalone RTL dark read-only browser viewer of public GitHub actions and manually imported, independently verified event-chain data.
Implement scoped CI tests; do not claim autonomous agent runtime is running.
out_of_scope: No live or automatic trading, deposits, withdrawals, broker/exchange API or real account access.
No automatic credential processing or external trading commands.
No unbounded specialist spawning, governance bypass or model runtime installation.
No production deployment, paid infrastructure, secret-bearing telemetry uploads or fabricated agent activity.
No changes to P04/F license gates, A5/A8 vetoes, frozen roadmap or existing Human Gates.
dependencies: FIN-P24-WZ-001 (governed watcher PR #532; conceptual, not a code dependency)
tests: GitHub exact-head Governance Verify on this branch
security_tests: Reject Live mode and unsupported trading actions.
Reject attempts to record tokens/credentials or sensitive paths.
Detect changed or missing chain entries.
Reject fabricated agent event state without imported verified trace.
Never authenticate agent identity based solely on JSON or local hash chain.
rollback: Revert only the ten new WZ-002 scoped files by a governed PR; no trading state affected.
definition_of_ready: No financial activation; only public read-only CI and offline trace import.
Exact WZ-002 task isolation from WZ-001 and existing WEB-P0.
definition_of_done: All scoped files in a reviewable PR.
Exact-head tests/CI and independent review complete.
Required owner-specific merge gate, protected merge and postmerge evidence verified.
GitHub and Linear workstream checkpoint synchronized; no full-project-complete claim.
